activeTask: Multi-page Material 3 Expressive design system (Direction A selected)

designDirection.summary: Selected Direction A (Cobalt Studio): authentic Material 3 Expressive across all 5 application pages with 5-level cool slate tonal surfaces (zero 1px border cages), Cobalt Primary + Muted Blue Secondary Container + Warm Amber Tertiary Container, connected button groups with overshoot-safe shape morphing, M3 Split CTA, radial ripples, tonal filled StudioSelect, and Cobalt-tinted M3 Expressive Shimmer Skeleton Loading.

artifacts.name: Admin Operational Issues Log Module
artifacts.notes: Operational issue triage with openCount badge, status filter, pagination, Unix ms local formatting, R2_FALLBACK safety reassurance, resolve action, and recurrence reopen demo.

artifacts.name: Retention & Storage Validation Helpers
artifacts.notes: Pure helpers for per-image/legacy retention summaries, UTC->local formatting, byte formatting, and R2 account/bucket/credential/retention validation matching backend rules.

experiments.name: Direction A: M3 Expressive Cobalt Studio

userPreferences: Avoid repetitive pill buttons and flat uniform border cages
Avoid overly concentrated beige/tan tones that flatten contrast
Adopt authentic Material 3 Expressive (tonal surface elevation, connected groups, shape morphing, split CTA, ripples)
Keep outer corners smooth without radius overshoot clipping during connected-group selection switches
Select Direction A (Cobalt Studio); discard Direction B
Design all 5 application pages matching the Direction A M3 Expressive system
Keep selected gallery items blue and slightly deepen blue when hovered+selected instead of reverting to unselected hover surface
Use Material 3 Expressive Shimmer Skeleton Loading placeholders whenever elements or images have not finished loading
Apply consistent radial click/tap ripple feedback across all interactive clickable elements while reusing a shared implementation
openQuestions: Approve the 5-page M3 Expressive prototypes under Direction A (including image retention, R2 storage management, and admin issues log) so Stage 6 production integration can begin?
nextSuggestedAction: Review /design-lab.html (Workbench retention + 410, Gallery mixed/empty/404, Admin Storage & Issues tabs) across desktop and 390px mobile, then confirm Stage 6 production integration.
